company_specific_kpis.commentary: Non-GAAP Automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits expanded +180 bps sequentially from 16.3% in Q2 2026 to 18.1% in Q3 2026 (+270 bps YoY vs 15.4% in Q3 2025), driven by lower COGS per vehicle, record Gigafactory Berlin production, and rising FSD software attach rates.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Automotive Gross Margin ex-Regulatory Credits: The pure profitability of vehicle manufacturing (18.1% in Q3 2026 vs 18.5% GAAP Auto GM), subtracting 100% margin regulatory credit sales ($113M).

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Delivered 486,532 vehicles globally (478,237 Model 3/Y and 8,295 Other Models), exceeding both Wall Street consensus and buy-side whisper numbers with passenger vehicle order backlog reaching a 4-year high.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Total Vehicle Deliveries: The exact count of customer deliveries recognized during the 3-month reporting period under GAAP revenue recognition criteria.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Deployed a record 13.7 GWh of Megapack and Powerwall utility-scale energy storage, driven by surging AI data center power demand and start of production at Megafactory Texas (50 GWh planned capacity).
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Energy Storage Deployment (GWh): Gigawatt-hours of utility-scale Megapacks and residential Powerwalls installed and connected to commercial or residential grids.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Active Full Self-Driving (Supervised) paying subscriber base expanded by +260k sequentially to 1.74M users (+67.3% YoY vs 1.04M in Q3 2025), with FSD now approved in 9 EU countries and Cybercab Robotaxi operating in Austin.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Active FSD Subscriptions: Cumulative count of active monthly recurring subscriptions and recognized upfront software purchases for Tesla's Full Self-Driving neural network suite.

company_specific_kpis.commentary: Regulatory credit sales declined to $113M in Q3 2026 (from $146M in Q2 2026 and $417M in Q3 2025). Because credits carry near-100% gross margin, delivering a $5,494M total gross profit (19.59% GM) with minimal credit help proves exceptional core unit economics.
company_specific_kpis.tooltip: Automotive Regulatory Credits: Pure-profit carbon offset credits sold to legacy OEM automakers who fail to meet government clean air fleet emission mandates ($113M in Q3 2026).
